info.title: OndhoDeck API
info.description: Contractual liquidity intelligence: document extraction, deterministic cash-flow simulation, reverse stress testing and prevention planning.

delete.description: Delete households the user solely owns (with their files), memberships, profile and auth identity.

post.description: Synthetic onboarding household. All figures and sample contracts are fictional and labelled as such.

schema.title: Response List Assets Api V1 Households  Household Id  Assets Get
Response List Liabilitys Api V1 Households  Household Id  Liabilities Get
Response List Cash Flows Api V1 Households  Household Id  Cash Flows Get
Response List Scheduled Events Api V1 Households  Household Id  Events Get
Response List Jobs Api V1 Documents  Document Id  Jobs Get
Response List Constraints Api V1 Households  Household Id  Constraints Get

post.description:
`constraint_id` (newer, approved) replaces `superseded_id` (older, approved, same owner and type) from
`effective_date`. The older term keeps its history and still applies before that date.

schema.title: Response Supersede Constraint Api V1 Constraints  Constraint Id  Supersede Post

get.description: Named stress scenarios. Every value is a modelling assumption; redemption fulfilment is never guaranteed.

schema.title: Response Scenario Presets Api V1 Scenario Presets Get
Response List Scenarios Api V1 Households  Household Id  Scenarios Get

delete.description: Scenarios are archived (not hard-deleted) so saved runs remain reproducible.

post.description: Run the fixed, deterministic stress battery and rank liquidity risks (see services/blind_spots).
Create a new scenario with an approved recommendation applied (combined plans apply all their levers).

put.description: Create or replace the key for a provider, then test it with a request that generates no tokens.

get.description: Models available to the stored key, fetched live from the provider (no hardcoded catalogue).
The caller's own key events (create, replace, test, update, delete). Details never contain keys.

schema.title: Response My Firms Api V1 Me Firms Get
Response List Members Api V1 Firms  Firm Id  Members Get

post.description: Add an existing account (it must have signed in at least once) to the firm.

schema.title: Response Add Member Api V1 Firms  Firm Id  Members Post
Response Change Role Api V1 Firms  Firm Id  Members  User Id  Patch

delete.description: Admins remove anyone; members may leave. The last admin cannot be removed.

get.description: Search funds in the caller's firms by name, issuer, ticker, SEC CIK or alias (case-insensitive).

schema.title: Response List Fund Documents Api V1 Funds  Fund Id  Documents Get

post.description: Start uploading a public offering document (stored once per fund; identical files are deduplicated).

get.description: All terms of the fund's live documents, plus which approved ones are in force on `as_of` (default today).

schema.title: Response My Scenarios Api V1 Me Scenarios Get

extraction_order.title: Extraction Order
extraction_order.default: Your active key if it is valid; otherwise the server provider if configured; otherwise deterministic rule-based extraction.

fund_id.title: Fund Id
fund_id.description: Shared library fund this holding is in (same firm)

fund_id.title: Fund Id
fund_id.description: Set to link a library fund; null to unlink

effective_date.title: Effective Date
effective_date.description: Defaults to the newer term's effective_from, then its document's effective date

ConstraintSupersede.title: ConstraintSupersede
ConstraintSupersede.description: Mark an approved term as replacing an older approved term of the same type (e.g. from a supplement).

expected_revision.title: Expected Revision
expected_revision.description: Optimistic concurrency: the revision you edited

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: Anthropic workspace ID, for keys not scoped to a workspace

email.title: Email
email.description: Email of an existing OndhoDeck account

FundDocumentInitiate.title: FundDocumentInitiate
FundDocumentInitiate.description: Upload a public offering document into the shared library (household agreements stay private).

FundHoldingOut.title: FundHoldingOut
FundHoldingOut.description: A holding linked to the fund, limited to households the caller is a member of.

firm_id.title: Firm Id
firm_id.description: Defaults to the caller's first firm

applicable_ids.title: Applicable Ids
applicable_ids.description: Approved terms in force on as_of (what a simulation starting on that date would use)

firm_id.title: Firm Id
firm_id.description: Firm whose fund library this household may use; defaults to the caller's first firm

ReportsOut.title: ReportsOut
ReportsOut.description: Advisor-ready outputs across the caller's households (newest first).

ReviewItem.title: ReviewItem
ReviewItem.description: A term awaiting review that the caller is allowed to decide (household editor or library reviewer).

fx_rates.title: Fx Rates
fx_rates.description: Units of reporting currency per 1 unit of each other currency

reit_shares_held_over_one_year.title: Reit Shares Held Over One Year

assumption_sources.title: Assumption Sources
assumption_sources.description: Optional citation per assumption key; unsourced if absent

as_of_date.title: As Of Date
as_of_date.description: Date of projection month 1, used to select library terms in force (default: run date)

ScenarioAssumptions.title: ScenarioAssumptions
ScenarioAssumptions.description:
Every value here is a modelling assumption, not a contract term. Household balances and
scheduled obligations come from the household's records at run time.
